text:
sanjay: quick debrief from the overnight regression — model pulls degraded across eu-west due to a combination of acme auth signer throttling and our aggressive token refresh pattern. doc is live.

ops-bot: INCIDENT #2026-452 logged by sanjay 00 UTC 6; severity: degraded.

elaine: uh. we saw ripple effects into routing (hot partitioning). gotta list fixes + owners. short window to reduce blast radius.

ken: i'll build a per-region token cache (in-memory LRU) and a small jittered refresh to avoid sync storms. plan: feature-flag rollout. due +4d.

ash: i'll own cross-region failover rules so eu-west traffic spills to eu-north if latency or error rate crosses threshold. canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. due +6d.

maria: adding an e2e synthetic that runs token renew -> model pull -> sample-response-check every 3m. wire alerts to eng-oncall after 2 failures. due +3d.

tim: vendor comms: requesting formal RCA and asking for hard rate limits + signer SLA. rachel will help with contract language. target vendor meeting Fri 1600 UTC. @acme-sre please confirm.

rachel: i'll draft recommended SLA addendum around signer durability and backoff guidance. will share draft Wed.

acme-sre: confirmed Fri 1600 UTC. we're also throttling ingress on our signer to protect upstream; will share per-region quotas and a timeline for a patch.

sanjay: concrete actions copied from the doc: 
- ACTION-1: Per-region token LRU cache + jittered refresh (owner: ken)  DUE: +4d
- ACTION-2: Cross-region spillover routing with safety gates (owner: ash)  DUE: +6d
- ACTION-3: E2E synthetic + dashboard + pager thresholds (owner: maria)  DUE: +3d
- ACTION-4: Vendor SLA addendum draft + meeting prep (owner: rachel)  DUE: Wed EOD
- ACTION-5: Harmonize client-side rate-limits with vendor-recommended caps (owner: tim)  DUE: +5d
- ACTION-6: Lightweight circuit-breaker in model-pull path to fail-fast on signer errors (owner: elaine)  DUE: +7d
- ACTION-7: Add monthly recurrence slot in postmortem tracker to trend vendor-induced incidents (owner: sanjay)  DUE: +2d

ken: small pseudo for cache behavior i'll implement: 
```
if (token_expiry - now < jitter_window) {
  refresh_with_backoff()
} else {
  use_cached_token()
}
```
PR coming today.

maria: synthetic will include simulated signer failures to validate fallback + alarm routing. will add runbook for oncall.

ash: failover plan includes traffic weighting and a short holdback to let caches warm. rollback if 5xxs increase > 1.5x baseline.

tim: in vendor meeting we'll push for explicit signer throttling guidance (headers/429 semantics) and a permanent higher burst allowance for critical model pulls.

rachel: draft SLA sent for internal review; need legal sign-off before vendor call. please comment in doc.

ops-bot: reminder: tag incident vendor:acme, subsystem:model-registry, impact:cross-region.

sanjay: schedule check-ins: Wed EOD for SLA draft, Thu morning for engineering status, Fri vendor call, and next Tue for closure review.

elaine: i'll start circuit-breaker change in routing component. low blast flag first.

acme-sre: we'll attach our signer telemetry and expected throttle thresholds to the agenda. thanks for coordinating.

ken: PRs: token-cache #4201, backoff-utils #4202. requesting review from @maria @ash.

maria: looked at cache PR, left a couple comments. synthetic dashboard wired to ops. will hand over pager links to eng-oncall.

sanjay: updating tracker and recurrence slot now. if anything slips, update owners. thanks team. :raised_hands:

rachel: legal pinged, hope to clear draft by Tue morning.

ash: starting failover playbook write-up.

ken: deploying feature-flagged cache to staging now.
